thresholds.note: DRAFT, set from the calibration half only. Becomes frozen (status 'frozen' and a date) before the holdout half is scored. The video gives no cut-offs; these are my choices, taken from the numbers he says aloud (RSI 30-35 for QQQ, 'lower band', 'oversold') and from common defaults.

lower_band.meaning: close at or below the lower Bollinger band (pct_b = (close - lower) / (upper - lower))

oversold.meaning: RSI(14) at or below 35 (he says 30-35 for QQQ)

stretched_up.meaning: close in the top 5% of the band after a gain of at least 10% over 15 trading days
